speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have right knee swelling and a family history of similar issues; are you experiencing any pain or difficulty moving the knee, and has anyone in your family been diagnosed with conditions like gout or hemophilia?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency). 

I am concerned about the lack of trauma and the family history of bleeding disorders. Do you or the boy experience easy bruising or bleeding from minor cuts elsewhere on the body?
